name: Asotin County, WA
findings: Asotin County has 65 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Asotin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Asotin County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
